[[File:Brentaal_IV_moonbase.jpg|thumb|right|The Brentaal IV moonbase]]
'''Brentaal's moonbase''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military installation located on one of the moons of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was protected by [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].

During the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], the moonbase was captured by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic task force (Brentaal IV)|forces]] and used as a staging ground for an assault on Brentaal IV itself.
